senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. אֲנָךְ II; cmp. אִינָּךְ) I.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02142"><he>אָנוֹךְ</he></cite>.
Sabb. 105ᵃ א׳ נוטריקון anokhi may be interpreted as an acrostichon א̇נא נֹפשי כ̇תבית י̇הבית I myself have written, have given (the Law). Pesik. Baḥod. p. 109ᵇ; v. אָנוֹךְ.—Pl. אֲנַחְנוּ, נַחְנוּ.
<cite ref="Berakhot 14b:10">Ber. 14ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. V. <cite ref="A02217"><he>אֲנִי</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02141"><he>אָנוּ</he></cite>.
